title: The Coin in the Fish
reflectionQuestion: God gave Peter what he needed in such a funny way. I wonder what little worry you could hand to God today?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Miracles). Batch D 'weird-funny / replayability' piece -- SHORT-ONLY by design (Adam: the charm is the punchy brevity, 'Done.'). The delightfully strange detail (a coin inside a fish's mouth) IS the hook -- kids remember weird details forever. Room = God provides / God takes care of the little worries too, sometimes in ways that make you laugh. Kept light and quick; Peter trusts, obeys, laughs. Soft close ('laugh'). VOICE_BARNABAS_ENCOURAGER (warm, light, twinkly).
